comments.body:
Thanks for the fix! We're closing this because the code path it changes is barely used.

`_download_folder` has one caller, `download_from_gdrive`, which is exported as `sy.download_from_gdrive()`. Nothing in the repo (code, tests or notebooks) calls `download_from_gdrive`. So the missing pagination only matters when a user calls `sy.download_from_gdrive()` on a Drive folder with more than one page of files (100 by default).
